start: Profile, Body (screen 'Body'), body weight chip selected

user_sees: Screen 'Add measures', 'Fill in any you like.', Date row set to today, number boxes
must_not: Yesterday's date by default; boxes in the wrong unit

user_sees: Back on Body; the weigh-in in History and on the chart
must_not: A second weigh-in for the same day without asking; the value changed by rounding

steps.action: Add a second weigh-in another day
user_sees: A line chart of the two days
must_not: 'Add it again on another day to see a graph.' still showing with two days

start: Member is in a gym whose trainer recorded a measurement (gym_body_measurements)

user_sees: Trainer's entries marked 'From <gym>'; History heading 'Tap your own entry to fix or delete it. Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: A gym entry that opens the fix sheet; another member's entries

steps.action: On a day with both an own and a gym entry
user_sees: Only the member's own entry for that day
must_not: Both on the same day, or the gym's hiding the member's own

user_sees: The kept copy of the gym's entries
must_not: An error that hides the member's own entries

user_sees: Its own chart and History, or 'No <measure> entries yet'
must_not: Body weight values under the waist chip

steps.action: Add measures with a picture: 'Take a picture'
user_sees: The picture kept with the day's entry
must_not: The picture saved under another day after the Date is changed

user_sees: 'Nothing to save' — 'Type at least one measure, or add a picture.'
'Check the numbers' — '<measure>: type a number above 0, like 82.5.'

steps.action: Type 8.25 when the last weigh-in was 82.5
user_sees: A typo question with 'Keep it' and 'Fix it'
must_not: The odd value saved without asking

steps.action: Refuse the camera at 'Take a picture'
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed. Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.'

start: Body, History has a weigh-in on 3 Nov

steps.action: Tap it; sheet 'Fix this weigh-in'; change the date to a day that already has one
user_sees: '<date> already has Body weight …' — 'Replace it with this one?' with 'Replace'
must_not: The other day's entry replaced without asking
The replaced entry gone with no undo

user_sees: Both entries back as they were
must_not: Undo failing with no word (the undo errors are swallowed)

start: Member logs body weight; member is in a gym

must_not: Body weight sent to the gym, shown on the leaderboard or to gym mates

steps.action: Gym trainer opens the member's progress in the panel
user_sees: Only the trainer's own measurements and allowed workout data
must_not: The member's own weigh-ins or body pictures
